long_biography.plain_text:
Warner Music Group became a defining example of Sir Len Blavatnik's investment style. Access Industries acquired the record company when digital disruption clouded the industry's prospects, repositioned it around streaming and returned it to public markets at a much higher valuation. The strategy relied on long-term ownership and operational transformation.

Scientific research is a major focus of his philanthropy. The Blavatnik Awards recognise early-career researchers, while Oxford's Blavatnik School of Government gives his support a permanent public-policy institution. A Harvard fellowship also helps life-science researchers turn laboratory work into companies.
